context: Tests whether the SDK skill enforces traceable endpoint changes across request types, response parsing, errors, tests, and docs.

checklist.name: checks_sources_of_truth
checklist.description: Starts by checking backend behavior/tests and current first-party app usage before widening the SDK public surface.

checklist.name: updates_request_response_errors_together
checklist.description: Requires request input type or query model, response parser/model, and operation-specific error mapping to be updated together.

checklist.name: adds_public_client_surface
checklist.description: Includes adding or updating the public method, namespace, or export in a domain-first API shape.

checklist.name: requires_deterministic_tests
checklist.description: Calls for deterministic coverage of request shaping, response parsing, error behavior, and public client contracts.

checklist.name: updates_package_docs_when_public
checklist.description: Says to update README, API docs, release notes, or equivalent package-facing docs when the public surface changes.
